artworks.label: Strawberry pancakes
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE entirely new original standalone square 1024 x 1024 Glaze illustration for boba-bear-club. A miniature stack of three very fluffy cream-coloured pancakes on a soft strawberry-pink scalloped plate, a shy kawaii face with two cocoa bead eyes on the middle pancake, glossy caramel drizzle, a generous puff of strawberry-milk cream and two bright strawberry halves on top, a few dark tapioca pearls tucked around the base, one tiny sage mint leaf. Adorable premium soft 3D plush-and-clay confectionery sculpture, subtly fuzzy warm baked surfaces, rounded shapes, soft daylight, cream/caramel/strawberry-pink palette matching milk-tea-cream wallpaper. Entire stack centered and self contained, no pudding, tea pot, milk carton, planet or cup. Whole subject visible, airy 18 percent clear margin all sides; readable as a small iPhone artwork widget. Truly transparent empty background, no floor, opaque tile, border or backdrop, alpha preserved. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, numbers, lettering, dates, clock hands, dials, calendars, UI, brands or watermark. Do not copy, recolour or crop an existing asset.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q92 method6; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
